description: Agent report for a period: art (taeglich|woechentlich|monatlich|jaehrlich — the last completed period) or von/bis (YYYY-MM-DD), ebene (alle|agenten|software). Returns the latest stored report for that period, or builds one on demand from the stored numbers (deterministic text, not stored unless speichern:true — admins/planners). Sections: header with data timestamp (Swiss time), notices (red fitness, handoffs >24h, new error kinds, runs >1M tokens, cache rate drop), fitness traffic light, success/failure per workflow, tasks good/bad with trend and example cases, error kinds new/recurring, frustration signals, savings vs manual work and vs classic software (estimate, with certainty), consumption (tokens input/cache read/cache write/output per model, cache hit rate, CHF per agent and per order), optimisations (proposed/implemented/measured/rejected, effect before/after, algorithm conversions with CHF saved), software level, comparison with the previous period. Every number has evidence ids in zahlen. Admins, planners and agents. Read-only.

art.description: Report period; the last completed one (alternative to von/bis)

neu_bauen.description: true builds the report fresh from the stored numbers

speichern.description: true stores the built report (admins/planners only)

name: get_agent_report
